fusions.name: Lulling Ripple
fusions.desc: Sweeps the blade slowly around you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, stripping 5% of their armour for 3 seconds and slowing them by 20%.

fusions.name: Unhurried Thrust
fusions.desc: A long thrust at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slow Guard
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Calm
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
